name: zapvideo
description: ZapVídeo — vídeos de venda para WhatsApp em 2 minutos (MVP)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w packages/video"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/video -w packages/agent -w apps/web -w apps/bot
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,worker "npm run start -w apps/web" "npm run start -w packages/video"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n web,worker,bot "npm run start -w apps/web" "npm run start -w packages/video" "npm run start -w apps/bot"
